Mission r1-web-fc45eff2-3378-4ebd-8682-006ac71fac0a. Specification sha256 f4dce2697161ab18ede9acc1c185576c18488848fd8d9704c9eb294c2c6dacb2. Verifier contract r1-static-task-tracker-v1, digest 4857e261da19afefcf3bcfa80879b5a1d286963a42495d8fa97f90aa30d01bb8.

SCOPE (verbatim): Only the local product/ static source tree and its registered artifacts. Create only the source files needed there; no reports, duplicate root-level files, tests or unrelated artifacts. No external content or network grants, no package installation/build scripts, no deployment, no external publication, no changes to host configuration or other missions. Do not create or edit independent verification receipts. Use the approved file tools; no solver-issued QA receipt can establish PASS.

FILE LIMITS: index.html plus local .html/.css/.js/.mjs/.json/.txt/.svg only. UTF-8, no symlinks, max 64 files, 1 MiB total, 8 directory levels. Zero-dependency: no package.json, no node_modules, no build step.

CONTROLS CONTRACT: one heading 'Task tracker'; textbox 'New task'; button 'Add task'; combobox 'Filter tasks' with values all/active/completed; list 'Tasks'; each listitem contains the exact task text, checkbox 'Complete <task text>' and button 'Delete <task text>'.

BEHAVIOR CONTRACT: initially empty; trim input and reject whitespace-only input; add via button and via Enter; render task text literally; toggle completion both ways; exact all/active/completed filtering; task text, completion and deletion survive reload; deletion removes only the selected item.

ACCESSIBILITY CONTRACT: the named native/ARIA controls are visible and keyboard operable; 375px and 1280px layouts have no horizontal overflow.

ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT: no browser page errors, error console messages, failed or missing resources, or CSP violations during the bounded scenario.

RISKS (verbatim): (1) A visually plausible or syntactically valid page is insufficient: every bounded real-browser interaction must pass. (2) Every resource URL must resolve inside the product snapshot. Use relative paths only; data:, blob:, external and protocol-relative URLs are not permitted. To avoid an unsolicited /favicon.ico resource error, include a local product/favicon.svg and reference it from index.html as favicon.svg, with no external or data: URL.

TOOLING CONSTRAINTS: only file_write, file_read, file_list and save_artifact are granted. Shell, browser screenshots, web tools and node are NOT granted. Do not attempt to run them, and do not substitute self-verification claims for the independent verifier. If a requirement cannot be met with these tools, report it as a blocker rather than expanding scope. Do not write any QA, PASS or verification receipt file.
